== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
Both slips use X Force in the power segment to reduce a starship’s immunity by X. The later slip expressly retains the reduction for the rest of the turn. Both allow the 2-Force cancellation once per turn for a senator or a Maintenance character. The later character requirement uses the printed Maintenance icon.
